kind: preimplementation source/coverage audit, not runtime/bytecode/performance proof

semantics.primitiveAPI: Expected Java IntConsumer.accept(I)V and LongConsumer.accept(J)V; parent will inspect actual compiled bytecode. No Java or javap executed by auditor.
semantics.defaultCallback: Default empty consumer remains passed and invoked for each element, including signature long section and offset/count int overload. This does not assume zero per-call SAM allocation.
semantics.ordering: Per chunk: interrupt check, scratch.clear, per element read with index increment, callback, reverseBytes/put, bulk CRC, work charge. All loops and callback bodies exactly unchanged.
semantics.exceptions: Same require callbacks and cancellation checks; Java Consumer does not swallow or wrap errors. Existing load catch policy unchanged. Work callback exceptions remain at same chunk boundary.
semantics.captures: previousStringId/previousEnd/previousPosting retain same mutation/order/ownership; replacing parameter ABI does not remove captured Ref or scratch allocations.
semantics.scope: private class, file-local call sites only; no public GraphWorkConsumer API, index format, query planner, pool, selected tuple or cache changes.

coverage.mappedSuccessAndCorruptCRC: GraphStoreTest.kt:302 split raw scans reuse exact matches from the existing persisted index; preferred mapped subsections at352-441 and corrupted CRC fallback at547-564.
coverage.mappedPostingOrderLimit: GraphStoreTest.kt:583 mapped posting merge falls back before limit when a checksum-valid range is out of order; swaps first two posting IDs, repairs CRC, asserts LIMIT1 result and fallback. Protects selected-range ordering outside changed helper, not exhaustive validator branch coverage.
coverage.mappedMemory: GraphStoreTest.kt:659 mapped posting validation stays bounded when complete index memory is unavailable; successful view path with limited/no range-cache memory and release.
coverage.querySemantics: ParallelDistinctDisjunctionTest.kt:21 and44 run with persisted index and require mapped view initialized, compare full values/order and selected tuples to independent graph.nodes oracle.
coverage.relatedRetainedRestore: GraphStoreTest.kt:2070 lazy persisted CallSite restore charges sidecar read validation and checksum work; :2172 interrupted lazy persisted CallSite restore escapes without publishing the sidecar. These exercise retained restore, not a dedicated mapped validator chunk-injection test.
coverage.gaps: No dedicated test for every property-end/string-id/trigram ordering boundary or budget/interruption at each primitive validator chunk; no new mirrored private implementation tests recommended for this mechanical ABI-only change. Existing module regressions plus equality audit and actual bytecode check provide appropriate evidence, without claiming exhaustive branch coverage.

performanceBoundary.coldEvidence: Prior cold four-OR recording: validator inclusive CPU 11183/13830 all CPU=80.86%, 11183/12243 application=91.34%; 94.24% all allocation sampled weight is boxed Integer/Long leaf (small amount outside validator). 40 query windows in one recording, not 40 independent JVMs.
performanceBoundary.hypothesis: Remove primitive argument boxing at generic Function1 invocation boundary while preserving all validation work. Allocation/CPU outcome depends on generated adapters and JIT; actual accept(I/J)V call and absence of valueOf/invoke bridge at that boundary must be verified.
performanceBoundary.nonGoals: No CRC batching, skipped callback/default loop, posting/rank index, cache or scheduling change. Old34 dense prior validator sampled CPU/alloc=0; benefit to old34 P95 and final10x remains unproven.
